# mws_metastore_iceberg (Resource)

Ресурс Iceberg-каталога. При создании обязательны "properties.location" и "serviceAccount.ref"; при обновлении допускается частичный "spec".

## Примеры использования

```terraform
resource "mws_iam_service_account" "example" {
  service_account = var.service_account_name
}

resource "mws_metastore_iceberg" "example" {
  catalog_name = var.catalog_name

  service_account = {
    ref = mws_iam_service_account.example.metadata.id
  }

  properties = {
    location = var.warehouse_location
  }
}

variable "service_account_name" {
  type        = string
  default     = "example-metastore-sa"
  description = "Service account name"
}

variable "catalog_name" {
  type        = string
  default     = "example-catalog"
  description = "Iceberg catalog name"
}

variable "warehouse_location" {
  type        = string
  default     = "s3://example-bucket/warehouse"
  description = "Object Storage location of the Iceberg warehouse"
}
```

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = mws_mk8s_cluster.example
  identity = {
    project      = "<project>"
    catalog_name = "<catalog_name>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `catalog_name` (String) Имя каталога

#### Optional

- `project` (String) Путь к проекту.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = mws_metastore_iceberg.example
  id = "metastore/projects/<project>/icebergCatalogs/<catalog_name>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mws_metastore_iceberg.example "metastore/projects/<project>/icebergCatalogs/<catalog_name>"
```
